outcome: Major neonatal morbidity (necrotizing enterocolitis stage 2 or 3, moderate & severe bronchopulmonary dysplasia, severe intraventricular hemorrhage, cystic periventricular leukomalacia, severe retinopathy of prematurity, or sepsis)
cohort: 7,698 very preterm infants admitted to 57 neonatal intensive care units in China in 2019
finding: While increasing maternal age was associated with a higher rate of small for gestational age, it was not associated with very preterm infant mortality or major morbidity.
birth_weight: Not specified, but lower birth weight was observed with increasing maternal age
